text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S didn't show up for training, but after searching around, I found her in the library.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Developing new ideas... by studying the past. To accomplish the mission—it is important to—learn from history.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I have made it a part of my recent daily routine.
choice_data_list: Training time is over, you know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I'll take measures... so that I'm never late again.

Seeing Symboli Kris S looking remorseful,
I gave her a firm reminder not to be late in the future.
